Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Join us and be part of the play!

  • Champion AI-driven creative workflows. Explore and integrate AI-assisted tools into the art production process, combining technical expertise with strong artistic judgment. Develop efficient, repeatable workflows that accelerate iteration while maintaining creative quality and visual consistency.
  • Prototype, iterate and innovate. Rapidly develop and test visual concepts, using player insights, feedback and performance data to refine the artistic direction. Embrace experimentation and adapt quickly to identify the strongest creative opportunities.
  • Provide artistic leadership and mentorship. Act as a creative reference for artists across game art, VFX, UI and animation.   • A player-focused mindset, with the ability to connect artistic decisions to gameplay and engagement.
  • Proven ability to influence creative direction, mentor fellow artists and elevate artistic quality without formal management responsibilities.

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About The Role

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Platform team that creates the foundation that allows our entire engineering organisation to move fast. This means building shared tooling, managing migrations (including our move from a Ruby monolith), and evolving our infrastructure.

This is a senior leadership role for a deeply technical leader who combines strong backend and infrastructure expertise with the ability to build and scale high-performing teams. You will be responsible for the architecture, reliability, and performance of all backend systems powering Wheely’s platform.

You will work closely with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to ensure our systems are fast, resilient, and scalable — enabling us to deliver the most reliable and premium ride-hailing experience in the world.

title: Engineering Manager - Machine Learning
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to join our Applied Machine Learning team to lead our squads across American football and ice hockey. You’ll drive game-changing initiatives using computer vision and deep learning at scale to automatically generate game data, event detection and player tracking - delivering critical, real-time insights directly to coaches during games as well as powering post-game analysis products. Our systems process thousands of games in parallel during peak hours, using models grounded in recent research.

As the Engineering Manager, you’ll:

  • Deliver for customers and manage teams. Directly manage members across two established squads, helping them meet quarterly commitments, resolve unknowns and engage stakeholders to prioritise high-impact deliverables.
  • Drive technical and modeling excellence. Set high standards across both engineering and data science, balancing model precision with execution speed and cost-effectiveness in cloud infrastructure.
  • Solve complex real-world challenges. Lead your team to maintain model accuracy across diverse, real-world camera footage and environmental conditions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work closely with product stakeholders, cross-functional partners and leaders to align roadmap priorities and resolve dependencies.
  • Cultivate an empowered environment. Foster a high-performing, supportive environment that enables your squads to operate at their highest potential and grow professionally.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

  • A proven leader. You have experience managing teams of individual contributors, including engineers and data scientists, and you love helping teammates grow.
  • Production AI/ML and computer vision experience. You’ve built and deployed machine learning systems and computer vision models at scale in production environments.
  • Balanced between engineering and modeling. You can push data science modeling forward while building scalable software, keeping a sharp eye on system efficiency, speed and cost.
  • A strong communicator. You easily break down complex technical trade-offs for anyone across the company and naturally build strong relationships with cross-functional partners.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Sports tech background. You have experience applying AI, machine learning or computer vision to sports performance or analytics.
  • Real-time systems experience. You’ve built or fine-tuned real-time data processing pipelines or high-volume parallel cloud workloads.

Our Role 

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

title: Senior Research Analyst - Caregiver Leave Cover
description:
Office requirement: Hybrid, 1 day a week

Employment type: Fixed-term contract – 9 months (Caregiver Leave Cover)

At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a  Senior Research Analyst to play a key role in our Research Services – Agency team in London, on a 9-month fixed-term contract covering parental leave. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.

As our Senior Research Analyst, you’ll:

As our Senior Research Analyst you’ll lead in the management of projects during all stages of the research process (client kick off, survey design to reporting), working across a range of research approaches. Our Senior Analysts are the face of our research, and working directly with research partners and clients is integral to the role.

You’ll be doing that for the agency world. Our clients are global agency networks and independent agencies, and no two projects look the same: at one end, large and complex multi-market trackers; at the other, fast-turnaround one-off studies. The subject matter moves around just as much, so you’ll be getting up to speed on unfamiliar categories quickly and switching between them at pace. Variety is the spice of life, and this role has plenty of it.

It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for a growing company is all about. So you’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment as we grow.

What do I need to bring with me? 💼

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for:

  •  2+ years experience in a market research role, including a significant amount of time with a research agency or media / advertising agency
  • Expert at producing insight driven client deliverables, narrative based reporting with experience bringing data to life through storytelling
  • Able to present succinctly and accurately, ensuring that points are understood as well as outlining questions/points to be addressed.
  • Confident in working with large, and sometimes complex, datasets, 
  • Commercial acumen is essential, both understanding of client businesses and putting deliverables into a commercial context
  • A solid understanding of how advertising and media agencies use consumer insights to shape strategy, planning and creative
  • Broad curiosity and the ability to switch subjects fast – one project might be drinks, the next automotive, the next something you’ve never looked at before
  • Exceptional attention to detail. Our clients make big decisions on the back of our data, so accuracy is non-negotiable
  • You get stuck in, take ownership, and give clients an excellent experience from kick off to delivery

Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, exemplified by our leadership team, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.

What We Offer 📝

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

  • Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
  • Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.
  • Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.
  • Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
  • Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
  • Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.

Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.

Interview steps 👟

  • Preliminary phone call with the Talent Team (no video required)
  • First video interview with the hiring managers 
  • Second (and final*) video interview with the hiring panel, often including a presentation, followed by a values conversation with members of the wider GWI community.

*Don’t be alarmed if there are other stages in the process; it’s all part of the plan for some of our roles.

 

What exactly is GWI? 👀

GWI is modernized consumer research; global, on-demand, and accessible to everyone, not just data experts. Our platform is designed for companies looking for fresh and insightful data about their consumers’ values, purchase journeys, media usage, and social media habits. 

With data representing the views of nearly 3 billion people across 50+ countries, GWI has become the go-to for agencies, brands, and media companies that want to know what really drives their audience to action.

Since launching in 2009 we’ve grown at a healthy pace, and to maintain this growth we need more extraordinary people. Hence this ad. Hence you.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🌍

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.

We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.

At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain network with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

We are looking for a visionary Principal Product Manager to lead our Stablecoins & Onchain Payments product activation program. This is not just a "feature-owner" role, but rather you will be the architect of how stablecoins & payments move across the Canton Network.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, the demand for stable, regulatory-compliant and programmable units of value has never been higher. You will define and own the strategy for Digital Asset stablecoin & payments activation on the network, ensuring that stablecoin implementations and payment rails are not only technically superior but commercially dominant in contrast to other networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and validate sustainable stablecoin and payment use cases on the Canton network, that can be activated together with institutional partners.
  • Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for stablecoins (fiat-backed, RWA-backed) and payments activation on the Canton Network, involving a cross-functional team of stakeholders and network participants (e.g. Tier 1 Stablecoin & RWA asset issuers). 
  • Work with institutional partners to design workflows that connect legacy payment & PoS systems with Canton’s privacy-enabled ledger.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure payment initiatives meet global standards (e.g. MiCA, Basel III) while maintaining the privacy benefits of the Canton Network.
  • Ensure that the scaling of stablecoin and payment use cases focuses on high-availability, security and low-latency settlement.
  • Define and track Key Value Indicators (KVIs) for the use case activation on the network such as Mint/Burn volumes and Transaction Volume/Numbers.
  • Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset. 

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3 years focused on stablecoins and payments .

  • Deep understanding of the stablecoin and payments stack.
  • Understanding of blockchain technology  is required and it would be great to have a familiarity with payments focussed layer 1/2 ecosystems
  • While not a developer, you can confidently discuss application architecture, smart contract logic, and settlement workflows with engineers.
  • Experience building for B2B or B2B2C environments where security, compliance and "five-nines" reliability are non-negotiable.
  • You are comfortable discussing business models, pricing strategies and tokenomics. 
  • BIG BONUS: Direct experience with the Canton Network, Daml, or building institutional-grade Stablecoin payment applications.
  • We are a hybrid workplace company, so you need to be willing to work at least 3 days per week from one of our offices (New York, Zürich, London or Budapest).

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d), you act as the electrical core of our robotics engineering team, taking complete ownership of our hardware platforms from early prototyping through to series production. You bridge high-speed autonomous robotic development with robust engineering processes, ensuring our hardware meets the highest quality and safety standards, and set up efficient systems and engineering gates that empower the broader team to work with clarity, focus, and speed. Your Responsibilities Own the full electrical picture: Design and execute schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, cable harness design, connector selection, and part specification. Drive end-to-end prototyping and series production: Build PCBs, circuits, and wiring systems, taking dynamic initial concepts all the way through to scalable manufacturing. Establish engineering processes: Build standard QA frameworks, engineering gates, and operational systems that allow the team to stay focused, execute rapidly, and succeed. Ensure quality, compliance, and safety: Act as the primary gatekeeper for electrical quality while navigating applicable industry safety standards and regulatory compliance. Engine for high-speed execution: Balance fast-paced autonomous robotic iteration with pragmatic, right-sized QA processes tailored to current development stages. Design motion system architectures: Develop and optimize 24V/48V power distribution, motor/servo drive integration, and sensor interfaces to ensure high signal integrity and thermal efficiency. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with firmware and software teams on board bring-up, microcontroller integration, and system-level debugging. Manage DFM/DFT and supplier relationships: Work directly with contract manufacturers and in-house assembly teams to oversee BOM costs, component sourcing, and engineering change control. We're looking for someone who has: Completed vocational training or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field. Several years of experience in full-cycle electrical design (analog, digital, and power circuits) across multiple companies, taking products from concept to market. Deep technical background in Altium, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32), motion systems (24/48V power, motor drives, encoders, sensor interfaces), and EMC/thermal layout strategies. Solid grasp of DFM/DFT principles, cable harness design, signal integrity, and direct collaboration with contract manufacturers. Proactive, end-to-end ownership mindset with a pragmatic working style and a drive to establish scalable processes in a high-growth environment. Very good English skills (German is a plus). Nice to have: Familiarity with industrial protocols (EtherCAT, Profinet, Modbus, CAN, Ethernet) and exposure to relevant standards/safety concepts (CE/Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, EMC standards, STO, PL/SIL). Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.” What that looks like day to day As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs. You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features. We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters. We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster. Who you are You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine. You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production. You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature. You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer. You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it. You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it. Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

  • You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

  • You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

  • You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

  • You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

  • You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The role We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time. You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers. You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals. What you’ll do Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution. Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early. Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs. Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion. Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence. Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs. Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels. Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured. Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion. Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach. What we’re looking for A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed. Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs. A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage. Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices. Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth. Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams. High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style. Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important. What success looks like The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Joining Coder as a Sr. Technical Recruiter is an opportunity to be a part of a high-impact, progressive, and collaborative team. We are trusted to represent Coder externally and guide all levels of the business in hiring decisions.

You partner closely with hiring teams and candidates from the first conversation through handoff to the onboarding team. You balance speed and empathy, providing a tailored and consistent experience for both candidates and internal team members.

What you’ll do here

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, from intake through offer, while keeping candidate experience top of mind

  • Source and engage candidates across multiple channels with creative, eye-catching outreach

  • Manage hiring teams end-to-end, providing proactive communication and transparent feedback

  • Track pipeline health, identify bottlenecks/challenges, and adjust strategy using data

  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in Ashby, Notion, etc. to keep hiring teams aligned

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience recruiting for technical roles, with emphasis on Engineering, Product, and GTM

  • Comfort discussing technical fundamentals, role expectations, and pitching Coder to candidates

  • Strong partnership skills with hiring managers and cross‑functional teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication; direct, respectful, and timely

  • Organized approach to pipelines, prioritization, and competing deadlines

  • Prior experience working in a startup environment and using Ashby ATS

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Substantial experience hiring for AI, developer tools, infrastructure, or open‑source teams

  • Prior experience scaling a high-growth company

  • Proactive approach to improving systems and processes for the team

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

Vous interviendrez sur la qualification d’une solution MES (Manufacturing Execution System), destinée à soutenir et à optimiser les processus de production, tout en garantissant sa conformité aux exigences qualité et réglementaires du secteur. Votre rôle et missions Votre rôle En tant qu’Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la qualification du système et l’accompagnement de son déploiement sur différents sites européens. Vous veillerez à la fiabilité, à la conformité et à la bonne intégration de la solution dans les environnements industriels concernés. À l’interface entre les équipes IT, les équipes de production, les interlocuteurs qualité et les équipes projet, vous contribuerez à sécuriser les différentes étapes du cycle de vie de la solution, de la préparation des activités de qualification jusqu’à sa mise en service opérationnelle. 🎯 Missions 🔹 Qualification & validation du système MES * Participer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de qualification et de validation du logiciel MES. * Rédiger, revoir et exécuter les protocoles de tests et la documentation de validation. * Préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, les tests d’intégration et les tests de non-régression. * Identifier, documenter et suivre les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution. 🔹 Déploiement international * Participer au déploiement de la solution MES sur plusieurs sites en Europe. * Accompagner les équipes locales dans la préparation, l’exécution et la validation des activités de déploiement. * Contribuer à l’adaptation de la solution aux spécificités opérationnelles des différents sites, dans le respect des standards définis. 🔹 Documentation & conformité * Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et qualité liée aux activités de qualification. * Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de qualification et de déploiement. 🔹 Collaboration & support * Collaborer avec les équipes IT, qualité, production et métiers afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins. Votre profil : Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes industriels, automatisation, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent. Expérience en qualification logicielle, validation des systèmes informatisés ou validation de solutions MES. Bonne compréhension des environnements industriels réglementés, idéalement dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou des sciences de la vie. Connaissance des méthodologies de validation et des bonnes pratiques documentaires. Expérience dans la rédaction et l’exécution de protocoles de tests, ainsi que dans la gestion des anomalies. Une expérience dans le déploiement de solutions sur plusieurs sites constitue un atout important. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques, qualité et métiers dans un environnement international. Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels sur les différents sites européens, selon les besoins du projet. 🏆 Conditions du poste * 📍 Localisation : Suisse romande * 🕒 Taux d’occupation : 100 % * 💼 Type de contrat : Mission de consulting * 📅 Démarrage : Flexible / Janvier 2027 * 🌍 Environnement : International et multisite * ✈️ Déplacements : Possibles en Europe selon les besoins du projet Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau
description: Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken! Dit wordt jouw baan Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan: · Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek. · Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject) · Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten · Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit) · Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers. · Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen. · Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! Dit breng je mee · Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator. · Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding. · Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit. · Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd. · Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit. · Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering. · Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 5.639,- €7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring is een uitloop mogelijk. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract. 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Voor de generatie die een studieschuld heeft opgebouwd tijdens het nieuwe leenstelsel is er een voordelige regeling voor de aflossing van studieschuld. Je kunt jaarlijks een bedrag van je brutosalaris inleggen om je studieschuld af te lossen. Dura Vermeer verdubbelt jouw inleg. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Liza van der Munnik via 06 34 15 71 45 of Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
description: Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing. Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE. Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen. We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt. YOU Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau; Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels; Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn; Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief; Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen; Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt). OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever; Een inspirerende werkomgeving; Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent; De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen; De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers; Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback; Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand; Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie. KEUNE We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter. title: Brand Designer H/F
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme la référence sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Nous recherchons un.e Graphiste Confirmé(e) pour faire évoluer notre identité visuelle, la faire vivre sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et faire de notre site web une vitrine attractive . Tu intégreras l'équipe Communication et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, RH, Product, la Direction ainsi qu'avec nos prestataires externes. Tu auras pour mission de : Faire évoluer notre identité visuelle sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et en garantir la cohérence au quotidien. Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients. Rendre accessibles des sujets complexes (gestion des dépenses, finance, conformité, IA) grâce à des illustrations, infographies, schémas et vidéos. Créer nos supports commerciaux et institutionnels : présentations, brochures, fiches produits, témoignages clients, documents corporate. Produire les supports événementiels, de communication interne et de marque employeur : stands, signalétique, visuels, publications. Construire une bibliothèque de modèles et de composants réutilisables pour faciliter le travail des équipes et garantir la qualité des productions. Piloter le design et les évolutions courantes de notre site web (cohérence visuelle, parcours, landing pages, intégration de contenus), en lien avec l'agence qui gère la partie technique, et documenter composants et process. Mener tes projets du brief à la livraison, dans le respect des délais et des contraintes de production digitale et print. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as environ 5 ans d'expérience en tant que graphiste dans un environnement B2B SaaS ou tech, en entreprise ou en agence auprès de clients B2B SaaS. Tu maîtrises Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign et Figma, ainsi que les fondamentaux : typographie, composition, couleur, hiérarchie de l'information. Tu as conçu des campagnes multicanales et tu connais les contraintes du digital comme du print. Tu as une expérience pratique d'un CMS (création de pages, intégration de contenus, responsive) et une bonne compréhension des principes UX/UI, d'accessibilité et de conversion. Tu utilises les outils de création assistée par l'IA avec pertinence, en gardant un regard exigeant sur la qualité, l'originalité et les droits d'utilisation. Tu es créatif(ve), force de proposition, autonome et rigoureux(se), et tu as l'œil pour repérer la moindre erreur. Tu sais mener plusieurs projets de front et défendre tes choix créatifs auprès des équipes. Tu parles anglais couramment pour échanger avec nos équipes européennes. C'est un plus si : Tu as une expérience en fintech ou dans les services financiers. Tu pratiques le motion design, notamment sur After Effects. Tu sais faire du montage vidéo (réseaux sociaux, témoignages clients, lancements) : un format encore peu développé chez nous, que tu pourras faire grandir. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une entreprise rentable, en pleine croissance, avec une dimension européenne. Des projets variés qui laissent une large place à la créativité : on t'encourage à proposer, donner ton avis et challenger l'existant, en toute autonomie. Un poste à fort impact : tes créations porteront l'évolution de notre identité et feront de notre site une vraie vitrine, génératrice de demandes de démo. Une équipe soudée et bienveillante, où l'entraide fait partie du quotidien. Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec la VP of Communications Mise en situation : étude de cas (présentation suivie d'un échange) Rencontre avec l'équipe. Télétravail hybride avec 2 jours de présence sur site à Montagnat (01250). Rémunération : 35K€ - 40K€ fixe + variable Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Pflichtpraktikum Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀 Aufgaben Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien : Gemeinsam mit unseren Account Managern arbeitest du zielgerichtete SEA-Strategien aus und sorgst dafür, dass das volle Werbepotenzial auf Amazon ausgeschöpft wird. Keywordrecherche & Analyse : Du führst umfassende Keywordrecherchen durch und kümmerst dich um die On- und Offpage-Optimierung, um die Sichtbarkeit der Produkte zu maximieren. Kampagnenoptimierung : Dein Ziel ist es, das Potenzial der Kampagnen optimal auszuschöpfen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Datenbasierte Maßnahmen : Du erstellst Analysen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung der Kampagnen ab – mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools behältst du den Erfolg stets im Blick. Reporting : Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, um die Ergebnisse der Kampagnen transparent für unsere Kunden darzustellen. Amazon Seller Central : Du bist versiert im Umgang mit dem Amazon Seller Central und nutzt es zur Steuerung der Werbekampagnen. PPC-Preisoptimierung : Du optimierst die PPC-Preise basierend auf vorher festgelegten Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass das Budget optimal eingesetzt wird. Qualifikation Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in. Selbstständiges Arbeiten : Du bist in der Lage, eigenständig zu arbeiten und eigenverantwortlich Projekte zu steuern. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe : Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden. Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit : Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist kommunikationsstark – sowohl intern als auch im Austausch mit Kunden. Analytisches Verständnis : Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten und hast ein gutes Verständnis für analytische Zusammenhänge. Strukturierte Kommunikation : Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert – egal ob schriftlich oder mündlich. Excel- und PowerPoint : Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint und weißt, wie man diese Tools effektiv einsetzt, um Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Daten auszuwerten. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist. Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben. Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur. Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Alerting | UK | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK. The Opportunity: The Grafana Alerting squad operates at the core of the Grafana open-source project (link) , and our mission is to provide the most in-depth way to let users manage their alerts. The backend-focused team works closely with customers and the Grafana Cloud teams to make Alerting work on-prem and at infinite scale in Cloud. The team's scope spans both Grafana Alerting and the SLOs product, so engineers get to work across two products that are deeply connected in how they help users detect and respond to problems. Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool. Our domain is quite large, so to get an idea of the kind of work we do, here are some projects we recently worked on: Build distributed systems to scale alert ingestion and delivery of Prometheus-based alerts Unify Alerting setup and delivery to work the same for Grafana and Prometheus-based alerts Build distributed systems to scale alert evaluation of Grafana-managed alerts, reaching over 500 evaluations per second in production. Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool. What You’ll Be Doing: Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve. Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must. What Makes You a Great Fit: You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action You are customer focused We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, Java, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others Compensation & Rewards: In the UK, the compensation range for this role is GBP 103,958 - GBP 124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

description: Du möchtest Amazon nicht nur operativ betreuen, sondern datenbasiert Wachstum, Sichtbarkeit und Conversion erfolgreicher Marken vorantreiben? Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz. Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen. Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich, deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet. Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. Deine Aufgaben Als Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager übernimmst du eine zentrale fachliche Rolle bei der strategischen Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Marken auf Amazon. Dabei verbindest du Datenanalyse, Marketplace Expertise und konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen. Performanceanalyse: Analyse der Marken und Produktperformance auf Amazon sowie Bewertung relevanter KPIs und Performance Zusammenhänge. Potenzialanalyse: Identifikation von Wachstums-, Optimierungs- und Conversion-Potenzialen und Ableitung konkreter Prioritäten. Amazon Strategie: Entwicklung datenbasierter Maßnahmen für Amazon SEO, Content, Listings, Creative und Advertising. Conversion-Optimierung: Analyse der Customer Journey und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Sichtbarkeit und Conversion. Category Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Category Management und Unterstützung bei Amazon spezifischen Fragestellungen. Markenbetreuung: Strategische Begleitung von Marken und Produkten sowie Entwicklung von Empfehlungen für deren weitere Entwicklung auf Amazon. Kundenberatung: Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Kundenterminen sowie Einbringung der eigenen Amazon Expertise als fachliche Ansprechperson. Präsentationen: Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Analysen, Handlungsempfehlungen und Ergebnissen gegenüber internen Stakeholdern und Markenpartnern. Erfolgskontrolle: Monitoring umgesetzter Maßnahmen und Bewertung ihrer Auswirkungen auf Performance, Sichtbarkeit und Conversion. Standards & Prozesse: Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices, Standards und Prozessen für die strategische Betreuung von Marken auf Amazon. Dein Profil als Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Amazon oder Marketplace Umfeld, idealerweise in einer Senior Rolle, im Account Management oder in einer beratenden Funktion. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Amazon SEO, Listings, Content und Conversion-Optimierung sowie ein gutes Verständnis für organische Sichtbarkeit auf Amazon. Erfahrung mit Amazon Advertising und relevanten PPC Kennzahlen sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Marketplace KPIs. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, aus Daten nicht nur Erkenntnisse, sondern konkrete Hypothesen, Handlungsempfehlungen und Prioritäten abzuleiten. Erfahrung darin, komplexe Analysen verständlich aufzubereiten und sicher gegenüber internen Stakeholdern und externen Markenpartnern zu präsentieren. Hohe Eigenverantwortung und ein ausgeprägtes Ownership Mindset sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und am direkten Austausch mit Marken und Geschäftspartnern. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Nice to have: Erfahrung in der Betreuung mehrerer Marken oder Produktkategorien. Praxis in der Zusammenarbeit mit Category Management, Brand Management oder Key Account Management. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. segmentation, update control, logging Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.
