And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. raw.title: Carrot: Sr. IT Systems Engineer
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 

Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
  • Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
  • Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
  • Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
  • Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
  • Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
  • Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
  • Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
  • Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
  • Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
  • Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
  • Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You

You likely have:

  • 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access
  • Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration
  • Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams
  • A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts
  • Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations
  • Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

Why This Role Matters

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

  • Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: DevOps Engineer, Edge and Developer Experience (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
description: Headquarters: -REMOTE, BULGARIA- For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join the Edge and Developer Experience team. Our team collaboratively operates Smartsheet's high-performance edge proxy platform and drives the adoption of internal engineering tooling. The edge proxy serves as the entry point for all traffic across Smartsheet's commercial and FedRAMP-authorized US Government environments. The team supports the lifecycle of this platform: from maintaining proxy configurations, to provisioning the multi-region AWS EKS infrastructure it runs on, to assisting with observability. Beyond the edge layer, the team also drives the integration of internal developer tooling — from а developer portal (IDP) to standardized CI/CD pipelines — that improves the engineering experience and velocity across the company. You will work remotely from Bulgaria and report to one of our engineering leaders in Bulgaria. You will: Contribute to the edge proxy platform: Assist in maintaining, upgrading, and extending a high-performance reverse proxy. This includes writing Go and Python automation, managing container images on hardened Linux bases, and working with CDN and traffic management capabilities. Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code: Implement Terraform/Terragrunt modules and live environment configurations for EKS clusters, load balancers, IAM roles, and supporting AWS services. Operate Kubernetes clusters: Assist in managing multi-region EKS deployments via GitOps workflows (e.g., FluxCD, ArgoCD) and Helm charts. Support CI/CD pipelines: Help design, maintain, and improve shared GitLab CI/CD pipeline templates used across team repositories, embedding DevSecOps guardrails. Automate operational toil: Build tooling for tasks such as container image patching, EKS AMI rotation, and automated patching cycles. Manage observability: Help provision and maintain Datadog SLOs, monitors, and dashboards; participate in the team's on-call rotation responding to incidents. Support Developer Experience initiatives: Assist in the rollout and integration of various platforms to reduce cognitive load for engineering teams. Apply AI tools: Leverage AI-based workflows within your domain to improve project execution, infrastructure design, and debugging. You Have: 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering. A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure. Experience with Kubernetes operations and AWS services (EKS, VPC, IAM, ECR). Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language — Go or Python preferred — for building operational automation. Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD preferred). Familiarity with container image security practices and GitOps workflows. A strong operational mindset with a willingness to participate in on-call rotations and incident response. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Fluency in English is required. Familiarity with leveraging AI-based workflows to author or maintain code/infrastructure. Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis. Nice to Have: Understanding of reverse proxies, API gateways, or load balancers (NGINX, HAProxy, or equivalent). Familiarity with FedRAMP or AWS GovCloud operational constraints. Experience managing Datadog resources via infrastructure as code. Experience integrating internal developer portals or feature flag management tools. Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market-competitive incentive opportunity. Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Equal Opportunity Employer: Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smartsheet-devops-engineer-edge-and-developer-experience-remote-eligible-in-bulgaria

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. title: FTTH Security Expert
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security , OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing. Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America. The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

description: Du machst aus unserem Support ein Team, das Kund:innen hält und gewinnt Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: per Ticket, per Telefon, mit Fragen zu Tarifen, Rechnungen und Rechtstexten. Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon. Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise). Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht. Deine Aufgaben Team führen und Betrieb steuern Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter. Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden. Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen. Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen. Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration. Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt. Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote. Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen. Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen. So verteilt sich deine Zeit : rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher. Deine ersten Monate Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren. Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten. Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen. Was du mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken. Warum sich die Rolle lohnt Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung. Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen. Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen. Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT. Rahmenbedingungen Vollzeit Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen: Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert? Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie? Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?   • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

  2. Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie?

  3. Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?

title: Senior Designer
description:
When you join Exclaimer you will join a global award-winning SaaS provider with an exceptional revenue rate, ambitious growth plans, and an inclusive and outcomes-driven culture.

Exclaimer is a high-growth SaaS company with 300+ colleagues across the UK, US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We promote a people-first culture built on fairness, inclusion, psychological safety, and continuous learning. As we evolve into a multi-channel platform for branded business communications, we offer employees the opportunity to shape the future of global communication—while growing their careers in a culture where curiosity, creativity, and accountability thrive.  

We’re officially Great Place To Work Certified™

Exclaimer has been recognised by Great Place To Work® for our culture of collaboration, trust, and growth. This certification reflects our commitment to creating an environment where every voice matters and people genuinely enjoy coming to work.  See our accreditations to learn more: Great Place to Work® UK | Great Place To Work® USA

 

About the opportunity 👇

About the Role 

You will be the in-house design lead for Exclaimer's marketing team, setting the standard for how our brand looks and feels wherever customers and prospects meet it. This is a hands-on role covering campaign creative, paid ads, web and landing page design, events, and motion, working closely with the brand, content, demand generation, and product marketing teams. 

You'll also own quality. Our creative now comes from several places: in-house templates, AI-assisted production, freelancers, and agencies. You'll decide what you design yourself, what can be built from templates or with AI tools, and what goes to an agency, then review the output so everything we publish is consistent and on-brand. 

Speed matters too. Our core web pages need redesigning for answer engine optimization (AEO), and our partner and account-based marketing (ABM) programs are growing. You will help us move faster by building reusable, easy-to-use design systems and by using AI design tools with a designer's eye for quality. 

Key Responsibilities 

Brand Consistency & Quality Control 

  • Own the Exclaimer visual identity, keeping the brand system, templates, and guidelines current and easy to use 
  • Review creative from across the team, freelancers, agencies, and AI tools, and give clear, constructive feedback so everything we publish meets brand standards 
  • Together with the Brand team, decide which requests you design yourself and which are delegated to agencies or produced from templates or with AI, based on audience, visibility, and shelf life 
  • Build reusable, well-documented templates in Figma and/or Canva that colleagues can edit by hand or use with AI tools such as Claude 
  • Brief, direct, and review work from external design partners, and make handovers simple 

Campaign & Paid Creative 

  • Design full campaign asset sets so every touchpoint is consistent, including social ads, web banners, display ads, email and email signature banners, landing page graphics, and infographics 
  • Create conversion-focused ads for LinkedIn and other paid channels, working to each platform's specs and producing variations for testing 
  • Turn product imagery and UI into polished digital assets for paid, web, and sales enablement 
  • Tailor assets for partner and ABM programs, understanding the nuances between audiences 
  • Work with demand generation to use performance data to improve ad creative 

Web & Landing Pages 

  • Design page layouts, outlines, and imagery for landing pages and core website pages, applying UX best practice 
  • Work with the web, content, and SEO teams to speed up the redesign of core pages for AEO 
  • Hand off Figma designs clearly to developers and web agencies 

Events & Creative Concepts 

  • Bring creative ideas to events, activations, and content assets, from concept through to production files 
  • Design event materials across formats, from large-format banners and lightbox graphics to digital signage loops and giveaways 
  • Prepare print-ready artwork and work with print suppliers 

AI-Enabled Design 

  • Use AI design tools (for example Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, and Claude) to speed up production 
  • Test new tools and workflows, and document guidelines so the wider team can use them well 
  • Review every AI output for accuracy, brand voice, and quality before it ships 

Delivery & Collaboration 

  • Manage several campaigns and requests at once, prioritize clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of timelines 
  • Work with brand, content, demand generation, product marketing, web, and channel teams to understand what each asset needs to achieve 

Requirements 

  • Five or more years of experience in brand, marketing, or graphic design, ideally in a B2B, SaaS, or tech environment 
  • A portfolio showing consistent brand execution across web, ads, social, and sales content 
  • Expert Figma skills, including components, variants, Auto Layout, and variables. Experience limited to Canva is not enough for this role 
  • Experience maintaining a brand system, templates, and guidelines for others to use 
  • Proven experience designing conversion-focused ads, with knowledge of specs and best practice across LinkedIn, Meta, and display 
  • UX knowledge for landing page and website layouts 
  • Confident, active use of AI design tools (for example Midjourney, Firefly, Runway, and Claude), and a view on what the latest and best options are 
  • Ability to use AI critically, knowing when and how to apply it while maintaining brand quality and accuracy 
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines 
  • An excellent eye for detail and the ability to give clear, constructive feedback to non-designers 

Nice to have: 

  • Motion design and animation skills in tools such as After Effects or Jitter 
  • Short-form video editing in tools such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Descript 
  • Experience designing for events, print, and experiential activations 
  • Ability to read campaign data and apply it to creative decisions 
  • Experience building or editing pages in Webflow, HubSpot, or WordPress 
  • Experience designing for technical audiences such as IT professionals 

At Exclaimer, we’re proud to offer a benefits package that reflects our commitment to supporting you professionally, personally, and wherever life takes you. 

Alongside competitive pay, you’ll have access to generous paid time off, flexible working options including our XFlex programme and a “work from anywhere” allowance - plus enhanced leave for all new parents, regardless of gender, family structure, or path to parenthood. Our wellbeing offering includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, fully funded insurance and income protection, access to 24/7 virtual care, and mental health, legal and financial support through employee assistance programmes. We help you plan for the future with contributory retirement plans and savings support, and back your day-to-day wellbeing with perks like subscriptions to Calm and Blinkist, fitness and lifestyle credits, global travel assistance and a wide range of discounts. Wherever you're based, you'll find that Exclaimer’s benefits are designed to help you thrive: at work and beyond.
 

At Exclaimer, inclusion is more than a policy - it’s part of who we are.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We consider all candidates fairly and without discrimination irrespective of ethnicity, race, religion, nationality, age, gender, marital status, disability, neurodivergence, caring responsibilities, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We’re building a culture where everyone feels they belong and can thrive, and we’d love for you to be part of it.  If you require any reasonable adjustments or support through the application or hiring process, please email the team in confidence via

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - EMEA
description:
About the Job:

The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts guiding our new and expanding customers towards implementation and adoption and helping them achieve their desired use-cases and realize value. The best candidate for this role will be passionate about customer success with a keen interest in software development and DevOps, balanced with a strong sales acumen. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year over year growth. 

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer’s adoption on an ongoing basis. 
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: You’ll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success. 
  • Technical Guidance: You’ll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.
  • Prescriptively Sell: You maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.
  • Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You provide prescriptive guidance to customers to help them get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase. 
  • Build Champions & Executive Relationships: You are an expert champion builder. You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers’ organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you’re able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.
  • Renewal and Expansion focused: You are comfortable owning a number and forecasting on a weekly basis. You will work directly with customers, sales and deal desk to execute renewal agreements on time and to identify expansion opportunities within your accounts

About You:

  • Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities. You operate with a high level of urgency at all times. You thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment. 
  • Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You view feedback as a necessity for growth so consistently seek it out and give it.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You have a hunger for knowledge and are naturally a question-asker. 
  • Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.
  • Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and have a process for time management. You do not require a lot of external direction to prioritize your work. 
  • Highly Adaptable: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.
  • Strong Sales Acumen: You have a high level of sales acumen, strong negotiation skills and are eager to own a number. This is a commercially focused CS organization.
  • Natural Problem Solver: You have strong critical thinking skills and enjoy the process of solving complex customer problems. You are able to escalate issues when necessary in a clear, effective manner. 
  • Team Player: You collaborate well with others, know when to pull specialists or leaders in and keep others informed proactively. Win as a team!

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.
  • Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred. 
  • Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.
  • Experience working on a technical product, ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred. 
  • Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions. 
  • We will teach you all about LaunchDarkly, but you should have an existing level of technical knowledge and know-how.
  • Proven ability to advocate for both your customers and your company. You know how to be the voice of the customer in the company while mediating between the customer's requests and the company's vision.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. 

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @launchdarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains.  Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly  directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

title: Intern - Chief of Staff to the Group CMO - Paris
description:
Artefact is an AI-native company fusing engineering-grade delivery with strategic consulting to drive high-impact results. We specialize in accelerating end-to-end data and AI transformation, helping enterprises turn marketing into a predictable engine for business growth across the value chain. From strategy to implementation, Artefact delivers bespoke, scalable AI solutions tailored to our clients' core business challenges.

Headquartered in Paris, Artefact operates across 27 countries with a global team of over 2,500 employees, partnering with leading international brands across luxury, retail, FMCG, industry, healthcare, and finance.

To support our rapid expansion, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern) to join our Global Marketing team starting in January 2027 for a minimum of 6 months.

The Role

Are you passionate about B2B marketing, tech innovation, and generative AI? Do you want to work in an environment where your contributions directly accelerate business growth?

As the Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern), you will play a central role in driving Artefact’s flagship initiative: "AI-Augmented Marketing". This global project reshapes how our international marketing teams operate by embedding analytical rigor, agentic AI workflows, and operational excellence into everyday execution.

Working directly alongside the Group CMO, you will collaborate closely with regional marketing teams, data scientists, and business analysts worldwide. Fluency in English is essential, as you will lead international workshops, align stakeholders, and scale best practices across all Artefact entities.

What you will do

  1. Strategic orchestration: Support the Group CMO in executing the global AI-Augmented Marketing roadmap across three core pillars :
  • Analytics & strategy: Derive actionable insights from the marketing data platform to guide executive decision-making.
  • Agentic content workflows: Automate content operations by building and deploying an AI skill/agent library using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Lovable.
  • Global enablement: Scale adoption across international hubs by designing learning modules, documenting playbooks, and running hands-on training sessions in English.
  1. Go-to-market & revenue operations: Leverage AI tools and skills to optimize inbound and outbound funnels, drive pipeline velocity, and enhance Marketing-Sales alignment for sustained lead generation.
  2. Performance measurement & reporting: Build, maintain, and optimize full-funnel B2B performance dashboards (awareness, activation, ABM) to measure campaign ROI and surface continuous improvement opportunities.
  3. Operational excellence: Own and update cross-functional tracking tools, operational dashboards, and meeting cadences to maintain project momentum and organizational alignment.
  4. High-impact copywriting & editorial: Produce high-converting editorial assets (internal/external newsletters, landing pages, case studies, and thought leadership articles) while safeguarding brand tone and positioning.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s student from a top-tier Business School (Grande École de Commerce) or equivalent university program.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong data-driven problem-solving abilities; comfortable working with analytics platforms, data modeling, and reporting frameworks.
  • AI & Tech native: A genuine passion for emerging technologies, generative & agentic AI tools, and B2B growth marketing.
  • Communication & copywriting: Bilingual or fluent in English (both written and spoken) with exceptional writing skills across long-form, web, and newsletter formats.
  • Project management: High organizational agility, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset: Proactive, autonomous, results-oriented, and excited to collaborate with cross-functional, international teams.

Additional Details

  • Start date: January 2027
  • Duration: 6 months minimum
  • Location: Paris Headquarters (with hybrid flexibility)
  • Salary : 1200€
  • Opportunity: High potential for conversion into a permanent contract (CDI) based on mutual fit and performance.

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit solely based on merit and business needs, fostering an inclusive environment free from discrimination of any kind.

title: Data Scientist Intern - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Data Scientist, tu seras responsable de : 

  • La réalisation de projets de données (sécurisation de la livraison de vos projets)  
  • La communication de ton travail et réalisations au sein de l’équipe
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec ton homologue conseil pour établir et entretenir des relations solides avec vos clients et mieux comprendre leurs besoins 
  • S’assurer que tes solutions apportent des valeurs à la problématique client  
  • Rechercher et développer de nouvelles approches techniques pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes
  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer aux connaissances institutionnelles d’Artefact

  Tu es ?  

  • Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique.
  • Tu es à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.
  • Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème numérique et data et de ses technologies : web analytique, programmatique, DMP, Datalake, dataviz, data science, etc.
  • Tu as un fort intérêt pour les problématiques business. 
  • Tu as un esprit pratique et analytique, et possèdes d’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes, y compris la capacité de désagréger les problèmes, d’identifier les causes profondes et de recommander des solutions. 
  • Maîtrise du français (écrit/oral) obligatoire pour le bureau de Paris pour travailler en équipe et de l’anglais professionnel pour communiquer avec nos clients internationaux 

Le petit + : une première expérience (stage, projet scolaire, Junior Entreprise, etc.) en conseil et/ou écosystème de données est une valeur ajoutée ! 

     Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

  • Développement professionnel : CDI à la clé (85% de conversion) ; socle de formation (onboarding, retex, café tech, deep dive de use cases tech...) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants.

  • Environnement de travail unique : flexibilité télétravail; évènements d’équipe et d’entreprise ; localisation idéale dans le 9ème arrondissement !
  • Socle de formation (training day, Retex, café tech) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants 

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quelles que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination. 

Rejoignez-nous !

title: IAM Software Engineer
description:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

title: Director, Channel Sales - EMEA
description:
About CoreView  

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365.  Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.  
 
Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.  

Job Summary 

CoreView is seeking a Director, Channel Sales – EMEA to lead and scale its regional channel strategy across Europe, working closely with the VP Sales, EMEA to drive partner-led growth. The Director will own the execution and evolution of CoreView’s partner strategy across Northern, Southern, and Central Europe. This role will be responsible for managing and developing CoreView’s EMEA channel motion through a team of direct reports based in the UK, France, and Germany, while also building strong relationships with key partners across the region. 

The Director, Channel Sales - EMEA will play a critical role in expanding CoreView’s partner ecosystem, increasing partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, and strengthening go-to-market execution with GSI, System Integrators, resellers, distributors, and strategic partners. This is a highly visible leadership role requiring a strong mix of strategic thinking, commercial focus, team leadership, and hands-on channel execution. 

This individual should bring deep experience in channel sales within B2B SaaS or enterprise software, ideally in industries related to cybersecurity. 

Job Requirements

  • Experience in cybersecurity is strongly preferred.
  • Significant experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect sales leadership within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or cybersecurity.
  • Proven success leading channel or partner teams across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Experience working with resellers, distributors, service providers, and strategic alliance partners.
  • Strong track record of driving partner-sourced pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Experience building and executing partner business plans, joint go-to-market strategies, and regional growth plans.
  • Ability to lead a distributed team across multiple countries and create strong operating cadence and accountability.
  • Strong commercial and operational discipline, including forecasting, pipeline management, and performance tracking.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with direct sales, marketing, pre-sales, customer success, and operations.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility internally and externally
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced, and evolving software business.
Key Soft Skills 
  • Strategic but hands-on mindset.
  • Strong leadership and coaching capability.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Collaborative and cross-functional working style.
  • Commercially driven with strong business acumen.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity across regions, teams, and partner types.
  • Confident communicator with strong executive-level presence.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to operate effectively in a scaling environment.

Extra Credit 

  • Experience selling through or alongside Microsoft-focused partners or CSPs.
  • Background in Microsoft 365 ecosystem and governance solutions.
  • Experience in a business scaling its indirect route to market across enterprise customers.
  • Additional European language skills, particularly French or German.
Job Responsibilities
  • Define and execute the EMEA channel sales strategy aligned to CoreView’s regional revenue goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop channel sales team members located in UK, France, and Germany.
  • Build and expand CoreView’s ecosystem of resellers, distributors, and strategic partners across EMEA.
  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new partners in priority markets.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Create and manage strategic partner business plans to improve market coverage and commercial performance.
  • Develop strong executive relationships with key partners and act as a senior point of contact where needed.
  • Improve consistency and execution across partner planning, pipeline reviews, QBRs, enablement, and joint go-to-market activity.
  • Work closely with sales teams to strengthen co-sell execution and improve partner engagement in active opportunities.
  • Partner with marketing on regional partner campaigns, events, demand generation, and enablement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with pre-sales, customer success, and operations teams to ensure effective partner support and execution.
  • Monitor partner performance and make data-driven decisions around investment,prioritisation, and growth opportunities.
  • Own channel forecasting and provide regular reporting on partner pipeline, contribution, performance, and risk areas.
  • Help build scalable processes and frameworks for partner management, territory planning, and regional channel performance.
  • Provide market feedback on partner trends, competitive insights, and regional opportunities to internal leadership.

#LI-CW1

Coreview Values

Ownership Mindset: Take ownership. Drive outcomes. 

One Team: One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together.

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Husistein & Partner AG suchen wir eine/n Projektleiter/in Projektierung

Wir brauchen Verstärkung!

Du suchst ein spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, wo Du Dich weiterentwickeln kannst? Du willst mehr Verantwortung und Entscheidungen treffen? Du arbeitest zielorientiert und hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Unser Team plant anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Konzeptionelles Kreieren von Projekten in der Projektierungsphase
  • Führen von internen Projektteams
  • Sicherstellung der qualitativen und kosteneffizienten Projektbearbeitung
  • Sicherstellung der Vertragserfüllung
  • Koordination zwischen Büro und externen Beteiligten
  • Sicherung der Schnittstelle für nachfolgende Planungsphasen
  • Baurechtliche Sicherstellung der Bewilligungsfähigkeit von Bauprojekten

Deine Skills:

  • Erfahrung in den Phasen SIA 102 und im Projektierungsmanagement
  • Selbständige Projektführung
  • Führungserfahrung und gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten
  • Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit und Engagement
  • Gute Kenntnisse von ArchiCAD
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot für Dich:

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche und herausfordernde Stelle
  • Hohe Selbstständigkeit
  • Unterstützung durch unser Admin-Team
  • Möglichkeit zur Weiterentwicklung
  • 5 Wochen Ferien, ein moderner Arbeitsplatz in einem digitalen Umfeld
  • Kollegiale Bürokultur, die für Eigenverantwortung, Professionalität und Menschlichkeit steht

Genau was Du suchst? Dann sind wir gespannt auf Deine komplette Bewerbung als PDF-File an ----- z.Hd. Monika Reinhard.

Bitte stelle uns mit deinem Lebenslauf auch deine Zeugnisse und Diplome zu. Herzlichen Dank vorab!

title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement - Lyon
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e au service développement éolien et sous la supervision de la Chargée d’Etudes Environnement, vous contribuerez à la bonne prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux tout au long des phases prospection, développement et construction des projets éolien terrestre. En particulier les sujets suivants seront travaillés : Élaborer des notes d’analyse et des argumentaires techniques pour les volets environnementaux et paysagers. Participer aux actions de concertation et de communication autour des projets (élus, services de l’État, société civile, habitants...). Garantir la prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et le respect des réglementations applicables tout au long du développement des projets. Référencement et chiffrage des mesures ERCAS spécifiques à chaque projet. Définir et sécuriser des mesures de compensation et d’accompagnement dans le cadre de la séquence ERC des projets : exemple îlot de senescence Participer et suivre la mise en œuvre des mesures environnementales en phase de construction et durant les procédures de financement. Assurer une veille, analyser les évolutions de la réglementation environnementale HSE : Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via : Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques Qualité : Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs Requirements Votre profil : Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale. Vous maitrisez les outils cartographiques (Qgis) Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel. Durée : 6 mois Localisation : Lyon - déplacements ponctuels en Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Auvergne-Rhône Alpes (frais pris en charge) Benefits Comment faisons-nous la différence ? Des valeurs fortes et incarnées Un management de proximité Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante Une entreprise en constant développement Valorisation et développement des compétences Nos avantages sociaux Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société) Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Sous la responsabilité de l’Ingénieur électrique, vous participerez au développement et à l’ingénierie de projets d’énergies renouvelables (photovoltaïque, éolien et hybrides intégrant du stockage par batteries). Vous contribuerez à la préparation des documents techniques, à la standardisation des outils d'ingénierie et au suivi des projets en pré-construction, en collaboration avec l'équipe EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction). En particulier les sujets suivants seront travaillés : 1. Développement de solutions hybrides Participer, avec l’accompagnement de l’équipe d’ingénierie électrique, à l’étude et au développement de solutions hybrides associant production photovoltaïque ou éolienne et stockage par batteries. Contribuer à l’élaboration de schémas de principe, de présentations techniques et de guides de conception pour formaliser les solutions étudiées. Analyser, avec les ingénieurs concernés et les équipes EPC, les contraintes des projets et explorer les solutions techniques d’hybridation adaptées. 2. Conception électrique Préparer les livrables techniques nécessaires à la conception des installations : notes de calcul, plans électriques, schémas unifilaires et listes de câbles. Réaliser, avec l’appui des ingénieurs électriques, des visites de site pour analyser le besoin réel d’un projet sur l’aspect câblage et poste de livraison. Echanger avec les fournisseurs sur les offres techniques en fonction des besoins et des caractéristiques de chaque projet. 3. Études de mise à la terre et solutions de conformité au réseau Réaliser des études de mise à la terre à l’aide du logiciel XGSLab, sous la supervision de l’équipe d’ingénierie électrique. Développer des modèles et des trames de calcul standardisés, adaptables aux différentes configurations de projets. Analyser les exigences de raccordement et de conformité au réseau applicables aux turbines éoliennes reconditionnées. Identifier et évaluer, avec les ingénieurs et les équipes EPC, les solutions techniques permettant de répondre aux exigences du réseau électrique. title: Senior Influence Executive
description:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Department: Influence 
Location: London
