title: Principal Engineer
description:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

  • Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. No separate ivory-tower architect required.
    Reviewing and choosing well. You read far more code than you write, and your value is in the quality of review: catching the silent assumption, the security flaw, the architectural drift, knowing where models fail and looking there first. You pick the right tool for the job (Claude Code for a deep refactor, an inline assistant when that is enough, a sub-agent for parallel work, the right model for analysis versus generation) and you know the constraints differ by client, an enterprise like PayPoint or Natwest versus a scale-up type business like Zuto or OAG.
    Working with non-determinism. You see where AI moves the bottleneck and help people left and right of you unblock the value stream. You build with AI components but know success is no longer a binary, reaching for evals, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths as naturally as you reach for unit tests.

Technical breadth across the full stack

Exceptional means depth in at least one area but competence everywhere the system reaches.

  • Backend: an instinct for distributed systems (what fails, what is eventually consistent, where queues back up), APIs that age well, thoughtful data modelling, and an understanding that languages are mostly syntax differences you can close with AI.
    Cloud: cost-aware and security-aware by default, reaching for IaC, composing the primitives rather than stitching together managed services and hoping it works.
    Data: modern pipelines, governance and lineage, increasingly vector stores and embeddings, with data quality treated as seriously as production code because garbage in, garbage out is far worse once AI features depend on it.
    Web and mobile: past the framework arguments, with a clear view on what you would pick today, and able to build "good enough" front ends yourself with AI.

Full-stack here means seeing the platform as one system and knowing which levers matter most. It does not mean front-end work with a few Node.js servers.

System thinking, consulting and commercial judgement

At CreateFuture we work in a consultancy context, where many otherwise excellent IC engineers can struggle.

You know technology is roughly 30% of the picture; the rest is design, argument and reasoning, commercial and political acumen, and the clarity to frame outcomes for a COO, CTO, CIO or CEO in their own language.

You know when gold-plating is wasteful, you can name when a project's real problem is not technical and say so even when it is awkward, and you have a strong sense of what is durable versus what is fashion.

You are not the engineer who introduced the team to seven new technologies last year; you are the one who removed three and quietly made the remaining stack stronger.

Leadership mentality

Technical work is necessary but no longer sufficient. By default you raise the level of everyone around you, regardless of discipline.

  • Communicate clearly and frequently (documents, decisions, post-mortems, design notes); the written artefact is the machine-readable context we can feed to AI later.
  • Make decisions and own them. You don't escalate everything or hoard control, and you are willing to be the benevolent dictator when it is your turn.
  • Mentor in AI fluency, not just code: tooling, prompting and review discipline, so your team is twice as productive a year from now.
  • Need little line management. You communicate upwards, raise by exception, self-resolve, and can be trusted with financial controls.
  • Disagree well. You tell people they are wrong with evidence and no ego, and you change your own mind when you are shown to be wrong.

What we're not looking for

  • The gifted engineer who sits in a silo. This is a team game.
  • The one who is fluent with AI but ships without the guardrails and quality gates enterprise clients expect.
  • The one with strong technical opinions who cannot justify them commercially and gets defensive when challenged.
  • The pure manager who wants to orchestrate teams rather than get involved. This is about setting a new standard, not coordinating it.
  • The engineer who will not immerse in a client environment. This role will mean on-site work and trusted relationships built in person. We are not going back to working away from the client and being bypassed.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. raw.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards
raw.description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

You’ll build features on iwoca’s business credit card and own each one from the first line of code to the moment a customer makes their first spend.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds what business owners use to sign up, get their card, and manage it, on the web and in the iwoca Mobile App. It’s cross-functional – engineers collaborate with product and design.

The role

As a senior full-stack engineer, you’ll work mostly on the backend, and build the frontend for your features too.

  • Ownership. You’ll shape what the team builds next, starting from what customers need. You’ll decide how each of your features works, from the data model and API to how you test, release, and monitor it.

  • Impact. Business owners use your work every time they check their cashback, set spend controls, or freeze a lost card. The team releases often, and your changes reach them quickly.

  • Variation. You’ll write Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL, and React and TypeScript for the web. You’ll also work in React Native on the iwoca Mobile App, and on the Credit Cards CRM that operations staff use, when a feature needs it.

  • Card expertise. You’ll learn how card transactions work – from the card processor to the card scheme – alongside the engineers who build iwoca’s payments platform.

  • AI-first engineering. You’ll build with AI coding tools as standard. On the iwoca Mobile App, for example, the team writes a spec for each feature and reviews it before building it with Claude Code.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've built well-tested Python services for customer-facing products, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Data models and APIs. You've designed relational data models, ideally in PostgreSQL, and built and integrated APIs.

  • Frontend. You've written enough React and TypeScript to build and ship customer-facing features.

  • Product ownership. You've taken features from an idea to production and owned them once they were live. You've challenged a plan when it didn't meet a customer need, and offered a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Mobile. You've developed iOS or Android app features, ideally in React Native.

  • Fintech. You've worked on financial products, especially card payments.

  • FastAPI. You've built and run production services with FastAPI.

  • Internal tools. You've written software for operations or support staff.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Private Credit
description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow. Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work. Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows. You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time. What You'll Do Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats. The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. It continues post-close into compliance certificate review, covenant tracking, amendment and waiver analysis, and quarterly portfolio reporting, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring credit-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey. What You Have 6+ years on the investment or underwriting team at a direct lender, private credit fund, BDC manager, or insurer private credit arm, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, structuring, and drafting credit committee materials. Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time.

What You'll Do

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. raw.jobDescription:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

About the Role

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. We're hiring across all levels and will calibrate during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop

  • Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack

  • Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time

  • Turn agent output into finished audit deliverables, including structured workpapers that adapt to whatever template a firm brings

  • Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas

  • Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems

  • Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices

Who You Are (All Levels)

  • A strong full-stack engineer who writes code every day and wants to continue doing so

  • You've built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes. You know what breaks when real users and real documents hit an agent

  • Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you figure things out as you go

  • Energized by 0→1 work: you'd rather define the problem than inherit a spec

  • High degree of ownership; you don't wait to be told what to do

  • A genuine team player across the organization, not just within engineering. You'll work directly with PM, design, domain experts, and customer-facing teams, and you treat that as the best part of the job

  • Able to pick up complex domain concepts quickly. You don't need to know SOX or internal controls, but you're the kind of person who can internalize it fast

  • Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage

Higher-Level Responsibilities

At the Senior level, you may:

  • Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health

  • Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs

  • Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture)

  • Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

At the Staff level, you may:

  • Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture

  • Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design

  • Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions

Experience

Must-have:

  • Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users

  • Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration

  • Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec

  • A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts

  • Willingness to develop an Applied AI skillset including writing evals, using LLM observability tools, and being thoughtful about quality

Nice-to-have:

  • Startup experience, as a founder or as an early engineer

  • A track record of 0→1 projects you took from nothing to something people use

  • Experience working directly with customers, and comfort being in the room when they use what you built

  • Experience in internal audit, SOX, financial services, accounting, or compliance

  • Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Temporal

  • Experience with document processing, PDF/Excel manipulation, or evaluation frameworks for model output

Not a fit if:

  • You’re not interested in deeply learning about Agents

  • You’ve never built a product to scale

  • You need a fully specified ticket to start

  • You'd rather not be in the room with customers and domain experts

What Should Excite You

  • 0→1 on the biggest bet: You're building the agent and the product from scratch, on the ground floor of where the company is going

  • Real audit stakes: Your work directly affects what firms put in front of their clients, and what a reviewer is willing to sign

  • Customer proximity: Design-partner firms and an embedded SOX expert use what you ship within days of it landing

  • High trust, high autonomy: You're given ambiguous problems and trusted to define the plan

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with equity

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

  • Flexible time off and work schedules

  • Technology reimbursements

  • 401(k) plan

  • Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.

  • Wellness benefits starting on your first day

Our Values

  • Fearless — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls

  • Fast — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection

  • Lovable — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences

  • Owners — Execute and run the business with ownership

  • Win-win — Create mutual value and earn trust for life

  • Inclusive — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

title: Software Developer
description: D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies. D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L. D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally. Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations. As a developer, you will help make dreams a reality. We are looking for software developers who have a passion for technology and code. Beyond code, developers are expected to collaborate closely with others including technical product managers, designers and QA. Your ideas and perspectives are essential to making sure we are building the right things. What you’ll bring to the role: Ability to analyze and decompose problems into potential technical solutions Experience with OO design and proficient coding skills (ie: C++, C# or Java) Strong understanding of Computer Science topics including: data structures, algorithms, databases, distributed systems Experience in software development, preferably in a technology focused company Acumen with Artificial Intelligence tools Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or similar technical discipline D2L operates in a hybrid work style, with expectation of 3 days per week in office. This position is to fill an existing vacancy The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more. About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in San Francisco to join our team and to help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You’ll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you’re equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why this role matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

  • Make content

    Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials

    Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase

    Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community

    Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company

    Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

  • You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

In this pivotal role, you will take ownership of some of France’s leading accounts. This is a high-visibility opportunity to deepen relationships, explore new business avenues, and deliver

transformative outcomes within the accounts.

Reporting to our Director of Enterprise Sales, as a Strategic Hunter Account Executive at Databricks, you will focus on identifying, engaging, and securing new opportunities within the accounts.

You are a true hunter — establishing executive-level connections, uncovering untapped potential, and positioning Databricks as the premier platform for data, analytics, and AI innovation.

You will be leveraging your extensive hunting expertise, along with your solutions sales experience in selling technical solutions in data/AI, advanced Analytics to inspire the client’s vision and help shape how they leverage these technologies to drive business outcomes. Your success will be measured by your ability to generate demand, close high-value deals, and expand Databricks’ footprint within the accounts.

The impact you'll have:

Leverage your expertise to identify new opportunities and create use cases that demonstrate Databricks’ value and impact.

Use your commercial network and strong relationship skills to broaden our presence within complex organizations—engaging key decision-makers and trusted partners to drive growth.

Develop structured account plans that address your client’s business priorities and position Databricks as a long-term digital transformation partner.

Draw on your experience selling cloud-based solutions to navigate enterprise cycles, secure executive sponsorship, and deliver beyond customer expectations.

Work closely with Databricks teams and selected partners to deliver tailored solutions that meet the specific needs of the customers.

description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

Senior Manager, Global Benefits

We’re ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: EMEA - Remote · Reports to: Global Total Rewards Lead

You’ll own Dataiku’s global benefits programs across all countries where we operate. The goal: benefits that help us win AI talent, feel consistent and fair wherever people work, meet local requirements, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you’ll challenge how benefits work today and use AI to make them simpler to run and easier for employees to use.

What you’ll do

  •         Shape the strategy. Define and evolve our global benefits philosophy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, balancing market competitiveness, consistency across countries and cost discipline.
  •         Own the global portfolio. Design and manage health, retirement, insurance, leave and wellbeing programs across our entities and EOR countries, setting a clear global floor with smart local variation.
  •         Run renewals and vendors. Lead annual renewals, broker and carrier relationships, and RFPs. Negotiate on data, not habit, and hold vendors to clear service levels.
  •         Keep us compliant. Make sure plans meet local rules in every country. You’ll own US compliance directly (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500) as well as statutory and collective-agreement obligations in Europe and beyond.
  •         Manage cost. Own the global benefits budget and forecasts with Finance. Model plan changes, track claims and utilization trends, and bring clear trade-offs to decision-makers.
  •         Lead benefits operations. Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.
  •         Use AI to reinvent the experience. Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.
  •         Support growth and change. Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.
  •         Communicate clearly. Build benefits guides, open-enrollment campaigns and manager resources that people actually read.

What we’re looking for

  •         Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.
  •         Deep expertise in benefits design, renewals, vendor/broker management and benchmarking across multiple countries.
  •         Strong, hands-on US benefits compliance experience, plus experience with European programs and statutory requirements, including UK and French benefits and pensions.
  •         Experience managing benefits through both owned entities and Employer of Record providers (e.g. Deel, Remote).
  •         A track record of building or transforming benefits programs, not just administering them.
  •         Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.
  •         Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Why join us

  •         Real impact: shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.
  •         Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to Total Rewards, Finance and People leadership.
  •         Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

Are you an IT architect who is equally comfortable designing a cloud architecture and getting hands-on to implement it? This might be for you.

We are looking for an IT System Architect on behalf of our client, a leading Swiss manufacturing company based in Canton Bern. The company is on a clear cloud transformation journey and needs someone to own it, drive it, and make it happen.

The role

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and evolving the company's Azure cloud architecture end-to-end. This means taking ownership of Landing Zone design, hybrid networking, Entra ID and identity management, Azure Governance and policy frameworks, and security architecture. Beyond Azure, you will also take a broader IT architecture responsibility: defining standards, evaluating new technologies, coordinating external partners, and ensuring the company's IT landscape evolves in a structured and sustainable way. You will act as the trusted technical advisor to IT leadership and be expected to build internal know-how over time.

What we are looking for

  • You know Azure deeply, from having built things hands-on.

  • You are structured enough to think architecturally and pragmatic enough to roll up your sleeves when needed

  • You have experience coordinating external vendors and partners and keeping delivery on track

  • You communicate clearly with both engineers and management

  • You speak German fluently

Role info

  • Permanent position, 100% workload, Bern

  • Flexibility on remote work discussed at interview stage

Interested? Apply directly to learn more!

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats , nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés. Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série , avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes. Missions principales Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles , en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration. Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats. Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions. Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques. Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques. Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration. Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis. Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution. Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées. Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées. Requirements Compétences techniques – Indispensables Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures. Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques. Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration. Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés. Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies. Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés. Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système. Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire. Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert. Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées. Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais. Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide. Qualités recherchées Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails. Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles. Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire. Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques. Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes. Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables. Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie. Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail. Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés. Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants. Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide. Benefits Ce que nous offrons : Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux Processus de recrutement : Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min) Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min) Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter Rencontre avec les équipes 2 prises de références Offre Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste. Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.

  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.

  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.

  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues.

title: Manager, Professional Services Engineers, EMEA
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Manager, Professional Services Engineers, you will manage a team that works directly with customers to deliver installation, migration, training, and advisory services across the full GitLab platform. In this role, you will be accountable for the performance, development, and day-to-day management of a team of Professional Services Engineers based across Europe, helping them deliver high-quality outcomes in a remote, asynchronous environment.

You will partner closely with Technical Architects and Professional Services management to enable consistent delivery across implementation projects, migrations, and statement of work engagements. This is a people-first role with meaningful technical depth. You will step in hands-on with your team when needed while also building the operating rhythm, team culture, and delivery approach that help the broader practice scale. You will also work closely with cross-functional partners to improve utilization, customer satisfaction, and delivery execution.

In your first year, you will help strengthen team capability, improve delivery consistency, and create the conditions for a high-performing services team across the region. This is an opportunity to manage a team doing technically complex, customer-facing work that directly helps customers realize value from GitLab.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Leading a team of Professional Services Engineers through end-to-end GitLab implementation and migration engagements for enterprise customers across Europe
  • Partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Architects to support statement of work scoping and align the right technical resources to customer needs

What you’ll do

  • Lead and manage a team of Professional Services Engineers, supporting their growth, performance, and day-to-day delivery across customer engagements.
  • Develop team members through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career conversations that help them grow their technical and consulting skills.
  • Own delivery outcomes across your team’s portfolio, including implementations, migrations, advisory services, and statement of work engagements.
  • Monitor project health, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly or escalate when needed to keep customer work on track.
  • Partner with Technical Architects, Engagement Managers, Sales, and Customer Success to plan, scope, resource, and support successful services engagements.
  • Track team utilization, customer satisfaction, and escalation trends, and use those insights to improve team performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer situations, helping guide resolution while maintaining a high bar for service quality.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Professional Services processes, tooling, knowledge sharing, and delivery standards across the broader organization.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams in a customer-facing environment.
  • A strong technical foundation in software delivery, DevSecOps, platform engineering, or a related area, with the ability to engage credibly in technical discussions.
  • Experience managing or supporting professional services, implementation delivery, migration programs, or technical consulting engagements for enterprise customers.
  • Proven ability to navigate customer escalations, balance competing priorities, and drive clear outcomes in complex situations.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners such as Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Architects.
  • A delivery mindset focused on accountability, quality, and measurable results rather than activity alone.
  • Comfort working in a fully remote, asynchronous organization with strong written communication and organizational skills.
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and the ability to lead with transparency, trust, and a focus on team development.

On the Professional Services team at GitLab, we help customers adopt the platform in ways that fit their technical goals and operating environment through technical delivery, guidance, and enablement.

As part of this organization, we focus on hands-on delivery work across customer engagements across EMEA. We work closely with a sister team of Technical Architects, along with cross-functional partners across the business, to support strong project execution and customer outcomes. We are building a high-quality services practice grounded in technical excellence, customer focus, and continuous improvement. This is a good fit for someone who enjoys leading experienced technical practitioners, improving how services are delivered, and helping customers succeed through meaningful, complex work.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

title: Product Manager
description:
About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

description:

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at  

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects. The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition. The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.

Position Responsibilities

  • Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established – large, complex prospects and customer.
  • Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.
  • Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.
  • Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
  • Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close
  • Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer/prospect accounts.
  • Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI & TCO), technical and strategic value propositions
  • Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients
  • Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts
  • Negotiate and close deals following the company’s practices and processes
  • Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements
  • Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge
  • Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings
  • Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.

 

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree and proven sales experience.
  • Demonstrable success in software sales at the enterprise level; selling six-and-seven figure deals and managing an integrated selling team
  • Experience in the storage management industry
  • Deep understanding of the storage management or data management industry, products, competitors, history, emerging trends and changing marketplace
  • Minimum of two years success in identifying, building relationships and selling directly or with partners
  • Excellent communication skills, persuasive, listening skills
  • Background in IT infrastructure; SaaS Experience Preferred
